title: Drinfeld Correspondence in Infinite Dimensions
summary: In this article, we establish the Drinfeld correspondence between Poisson Lie groups and their infinitesimal counterparts, Lie bialgebras, in the infinite-dimensional setting. Specifically, we extend this correspondence to regular Lie groups modeled on convenient vector spaces, with a particular focus on those modeled on nuclear Fréchet and nuclear Silva spaces.
